subject: Commercial Pilot — Next Steps & Stakeholder Alignment
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@clearshore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial Pilot — Next Steps & Stakeholder Alignment

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we have alignment across stakeholders and dates. Please flag anything I misunderstood.

Key pain / goals you reiterated:
- Latency variability on search re-rank pipeline causing degraded UX during peak windows (p95 spikes).
- High per-query cost for embeddings at scale; current vendor lock limits experimentation with quantized models.
- Need for a predictable staging-to-prod path with clear rollback and SLA guarantees for customer-facing features.

Goals for pilot:
1) Validate latency SLO (p95 < 250ms for 99% of test queries) on a representative traffic replay by end of pilot.
2) Measure per-token cost improvements with Redwood Optimize configurations (target 30% reduction).
3) Evaluate quality parity for top-3 prompt templates across mixed traffic.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level) — please confirm stakeholders and dates:
- Milestone A: Pilot kickoff & dataset exchange — target 2027-07-28 — owners: ClearShore data (Emma), Redwood delivery (Ben)
- Milestone B: Technical deep-dive + integration plan — target 2027-08-03 — owner: Redwood Solutions (Ben)
- Milestone C: Pilot run (2 weeks replay) & cost/quality analysis — target 2027-08-04 to 2027-08-18 — owners: ClearShore & Redwood
- Milestone D: Procurement & executive signoff — target decision by 2027-08-12 — owner: ClearShore procurement

Open items / asks from ClearShore:
- Confirm procurement contact and target decision date (you indicated early August).
- Share a sample traffic replay (anonymized) and current p95/p99 metrics for our baseline.
- Any constraints re: VPC / KMS for pilot (if you want private deployment).

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.2.pdf — draft MAP with milestones, acceptance criteria, and roles.

Next steps I propose:
- Emma: confirm procurement contact + whether data can be shared by 7/26.
- Ben: I’ll set up the technical deep-dive once Emma confirms stakeholders.
- Lauren: prep a short pricing summary for pilot scope (CC'd).

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP doc and drive link once I have your procurement contact.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-MAP-v1.2.pdf (PDF, 290 KB)]

From: Emma Liu <emma@clearshore.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@clearshore.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial Pilot — Next Steps & Stakeholder Alignment

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side and adjusting dates slightly: 

1) Pain/Goals — confirmed. Priority is reducing p95 spikes during batch imports.
2) Procurement contact: procurement@clearshore.com (CC'd in case you need official paperwork). Procurement is targeting an internal decision window that concludes by 2027-08-12 — they will need a short vendor questionnaire and the SOW.
3) Technical deep-dive — we’d like that before the pilot run. Can Redwood provide a ~60 minute session that covers: architecture integration, KV cache behavior, and security controls (KMS + audit logs)? Prefer week of 7/31.
4) Data share: we can provide an anonymized traffic replay and baseline metrics by 2027-07-26, pending legal sign-off.

One note on acceptance criteria — for quality parity we’ll measure top-3 templates plus a small blind A/B on secondary templates; if Redwood can include evaluation tooling that would be helpful.

I’ve looped in Marco (engineering lead) for scheduling and any technical constraints.

—Emma
Head of Search & Personalization | ClearShore
